title.zh: 卷六十六 表第六 方鎮三
title.raw: 卷六十六 表第六 方鎮三 Volume 66 Tables 6: Military Commanderies 3

sentences.zh: 西元 河中 澤潞沁 成德 義武 幽州 魏博 橫海

translations.literal: Western calendar [CE]. Hezhong. Ze-Lu-Qin. Chengde. Yiwu. Youzhou. Weibo. Henghai.
translations.idiomatic: CE dates. Columns: Hezhong; Ze–Lu–Qin; Chengde; Yiwu; Youzhou; Weibo; Henghai.

translations.literal: 710, first year of the Jingyun era.
translations.idiomatic: 710 CE, first year of the Jingyun reign.

translations.literal: 712, first year of the Xiantian era.
translations.idiomatic: 712 CE, first year of the Xiantian reign.

translations.literal: 713, first year of the Kaiyuan era.
translations.idiomatic: 713 CE, first year of the Kaiyuan reign.

translations.literal: At Youzhou a defense commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: A defense commissioner was posted to Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 置幽州節度、諸州軍管內經略、鎮守大使，領幽、易、平、檀、媯、燕六州，治幽州。

translations.literal: The Youzhou military commissioner, frontier commissioner for armies and prefectures within the circuit, and garrison grand commissioner was established, holding You, Yi, Ping, Tan, Gui, and Yan prefectures—six in all—with seat at You Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Youzhou military commissioner was appointed as frontier and garrison grand commissioner over six prefectures—You, Yi, Ping, Tan, Gui, and Yan—from his seat at Youzhou.

translations.literal: The Yingping garrison commander was established, with seat at Taiping Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Yingping garrison commander was appointed, headquartered at Taiping Prefecture.

translations.literal: At Ying Prefecture a Pinglu Army commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: A Pinglu Army commissioner was posted to Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 升平盧軍使為平盧軍節度，經略、河北支度、管內諸蕃及營田等使，兼領安東都護及營、遼、燕三州。

translations.literal: The Pinglu Army commissioner was promoted to Pinglu Army military commissioner, frontier commissioner, Hebei supply director, commissioner for various tribes and agricultural colonies within the circuit, and concurrently held the Anton Protectorate and Ying, Liaodong, and Yan prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The Pinglu Army commissioner was raised to Pinglu Army military commissioner, with posts as frontier commissioner, Hebei supply director, and commissioner for tribes and agricultural colonies in the circuit; he also held the Anton Protectorate and commanded Ying, Liaodong, and Yan prefectures.

sentences.zh: 幽州節度兼本軍州經略大使，並節度河北諸軍大使。

translations.literal: The Youzhou circuit concurrently served as frontier commissioner of its home prefecture and army, and also as grand commissioner over all Hebei forces.
translations.idiomatic: The Youzhou military commissioner also became frontier commissioner of his home prefecture and army, and grand commissioner over all Hebei forces.

translations.literal: At Cang Prefecture a Henghai Army commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: A Henghai Army commissioner was posted to Cang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 幽州節度大使兼河北支度營田使。

translations.literal: The grand Youzhou military commissioner concurrently served as Hebei supply and agricultural colony commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The grand Youzhou military commissioner also held the Hebei supply and agricultural colony commission.

sentences.zh: 幽州節度增領薊、滄二州。

translations.literal: The Youzhou circuit added Ji and Cang prefectures to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Youzhou circuit gained Ji and Cang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 幽州節度使兼河北採訪處置使，增領衛、相、洺、貝、冀、魏、深、趙、恆、定、邢、德、博、棣、營、鄚十六州及安東都護府。

translations.literal: The Youzhou military commissioner concurrently served as Hebei investigation and disposal commissioner, adding sixteen prefectures—Wei, Xiang, Ming, Bei, Ji, Wei, Shen, Zhao, Heng, Ding, Xing, De, Bo, Di, Ying, and Mao—and the Anton Protectorate to his command.
translations.idiomatic: The Youzhou military commissioner was also appointed Hebei investigation and disposal commissioner, taking under his command sixteen prefectures plus the Anton Protectorate.

sentences.zh: 幽州節度使增領河北海運使。

translations.literal: The Youzhou military commissioner additionally held the Hebei maritime transport commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Youzhou military commissioner also assumed the Hebei maritime transport commission.

sentences.zh: 平盧軍節度使兼押兩蕃、渤海、黑水四府經略處置使。

translations.literal: The Pinglu Army military commissioner concurrently served as frontier and disposal commissioner over the Two Fan, Bohai, and Heishui four prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The Pinglu Army military commissioner also held the frontier and disposal commission over the Two Fan, Bohai, and Heishui commands.

sentences.zh: 幽州節度副使領平盧軍節度副使，治順化州。

translations.literal: The Youzhou deputy military commissioner concurrently led the Pinglu Army deputy military commissioner, with seat at Shunhua Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Youzhou deputy military commissioner also served as Pinglu Army deputy military commissioner, headquartered at Shunhua Prefecture.

translations.literal: 742 CE, first year of the Tianbao reign.
translations.idiomatic: 742 CE, first year of the Tianbao reign.

sentences.zh: 更幽州節度使為范陽節度使，增領歸順、歸德二郡。

translations.literal: The Youzhou military commissioner was renamed Fanyang military commissioner, and Guishun and Guide commanderies were added to his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Youzhou military commissioner was retitled Fanyang military commissioner and gained Guishun and Guide commanderies.

sentences.zh: 平盧軍節度使治遼西故城，副都護領保定軍使。

translations.literal: The Pinglu Army military commissioner had his seat at the old city of Liaoxi; the deputy protector-general held the Baoding Army commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Pinglu Army military commissioner was stationed at the old Liaoxi city, while the deputy protector-general held the Baoding Army commission.

translations.literal: 756 CE, first year of the Zhide reign.
translations.idiomatic: 756 CE, first year of the Zhide reign.

sentences.zh: 置河中防禦守捉蒲關使。

translations.literal: The Hezhong defense and Tong Pass garrison commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Hezhong defense and Tong Pass garrison commissioner was created.

sentences.zh: 置澤潞沁節度使，治潞州。

translations.literal: The Ze-Lu-Qin military commissioner was established, with seat at Lu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Ze–Lu–Qin military commissioner was appointed, with his seat at Lu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 升河中防禦為河中節度，兼蒲關防禦使，領蒲、晉、絳、隰、慈、虢、同七州，治蒲州。

translations.literal: The Hezhong Defense Command was raised to the Hezhong military governorship, concurrently serving as Puguan defense commissioner; it administered the seven prefectures of Pu, Jin, Jiang, Xi, Ci, Guo, and Tong, with its seat at Pu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Hezhong Defense Command was raised to the Hezhong military governorship, concurrently serving as Puguan defense commissioner; it administered the seven prefectures of Pu, Jin, Jiang, Xi, Ci, Guo, and Tong, with its seat at Pu Prefecture.

translations.literal: 758, first year of the Qianyuan era.
translations.idiomatic: 758 CE, first year of the Qianyuan reign.

sentences.zh: 河中節度兼河中尹、耀德軍使。

translations.literal: The Hezhong circuit concurrently served as Hezhong prefect and Yaode Army commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Hezhong military commissioner also held the posts of Hezhong prefect and Yaode Army commissioner.

translations.literal: Guo Prefecture was placed under the Shan-Hua circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Prefecture was transferred to the Shan–Hua circuit.

translations.literal: 760, first year of the Shangyuan era.
translations.idiomatic: 760 CE, first year of the Shangyuan reign.

sentences.zh: 河中節度增領沁州，以同州隸鎮國軍節度。是年，復以沁州隸澤潞節度。

translations.literal: The Hezhong circuit added Qin Prefecture to its jurisdiction; Tong Prefecture was placed under the Zhenguo Army circuit. That year Qin Prefecture was again placed under the Ze-Lu circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Hezhong circuit took Qin Prefecture while Tong Prefecture went to the Zhenguo Army circuit; later that year Qin Prefecture was transferred back to the Ze–Lu circuit.

translations.literal: The Ze-Lu circuit added Qin Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Ze–Lu circuit gained Qin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 滄、德、棣三州隸淄沂節度，衛、相、貝、魏、博五州隸滑衛節度。

translations.literal: Cang, De, and Di prefectures were placed under the Zi-Yi circuit; Wei, Xiang, Bei, Wei, and Bo prefectures under the Hua-Wei circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Cang, De, and Di were assigned to the Zi–Yi circuit, and Wei, Xiang, Bei, Wei, and Bo to the Hua–Wei circuit.

translations.literal: 762 CE, first year of the Baoying reign.
translations.idiomatic: 762 CE, first year of the Baoying reign.

sentences.zh: 澤潞節度增領鄭州，又增領陳、邢、洺、趙四州。是年，以趙州隸成德軍節度。

translations.literal: The Ze-Lu circuit added Zheng Prefecture and also Chen, Xing, Ming, and Zhao prefectures—four in all. That year Zhao Prefecture was placed under the Chengde Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Ze–Lu circuit gained Zheng Prefecture and later Chen, Xing, Ming, and Zhao; that year Zhao Prefecture was transferred to the Chengde Army circuit.

sentences.zh: 置成德軍節度使，領恆、定、易、趙、深五州，治恆州。

translations.literal: The Chengde Army military commissioner was established, holding Heng, Ding, Yi, Zhao, and Shen prefectures—five in all—with seat at Heng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Chengde Army military commissioner was appointed, commanding five prefectures from his seat at Heng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 范陽節度使復為幽州節度使，及平盧陷，又兼盧龍節度使。以恆、定、易、趙、深五州隸成德軍節度，邢州隸澤潞節度，置平盧防禦本軍營田使。

translations.literal: The Fanyang military commissioner was restored as Youzhou military commissioner; after Pinglu fell he also held the Lu-Long military commission. Heng, Ding, Yi, Zhao, and Shen prefectures were placed under the Chengde Army circuit; Xing Prefecture under the Ze-Lu circuit; and the Pinglu defense and home-army agricultural colony commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Fanyang military commissioner was reinstated as Youzhou military commissioner and, after Pinglu's fall, also took the Lu–Long commission; five prefectures went to Chengde, Xing Prefecture to Ze–Lu, and a Pinglu defense and agricultural colony commissioner was created.

translations.literal: 763 CE, first year of the Guangde reign.
translations.idiomatic: 763 CE, first year of the Guangde reign.

sentences.zh: 澤潞節度增領懷、衛二州，尋以衛州還相衛節度。

translations.literal: The Ze-Lu circuit added jurisdiction over Huai and Wei prefectures; soon Wei Prefecture was returned to the Xiang-Wei circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Ze–Lu circuit took Huai and Wei under its command; before long Wei Prefecture was transferred back to the Xiang–Wei circuit.

translations.literal: The Chengde Army circuit added Jizhou to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Chengde Army circuit gained jurisdiction over Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 冀州隸成德軍節度，罷領順、易、歸順三州。

translations.literal: Jizhou was placed under the Chengde Army circuit; jurisdiction over Shun, Yi, and Guishun prefectures was discontinued.
translations.idiomatic: Jizhou was assigned to the Chengde Army circuit, which relinquished Shun, Yi, and Guishun.

sentences.zh: 置魏博等州防禦使，領魏、博、貝、瀛、滄五州，治魏州。

translations.literal: A defense commissioner for Wei-Bo and other prefectures was established, holding Wei, Bo, Bei, Ying, and Cang prefectures, with seat at Wei Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A defense commissioner for Wei–Bo and neighboring prefectures was installed, commanding Wei, Bo, Bei, Ying, and Cang from his seat at Wei Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是年，升為節度使，增領德州。

translations.literal: That year it was promoted to military commissioner and added De Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: That same year the post was raised to military commissioner, and De Prefecture was added to its command.

sentences.zh: 以瀛、滄二州隸淄青平盧節度，貝州隸洺相節度。

translations.literal: Ying and Cang prefectures were placed under the Ziqing Pinglu circuit; Bei Prefecture under the Ming-Xiang circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Ying and Cang were transferred to the Ziqing Pinglu circuit, and Bei Prefecture to the Ming–Xiang circuit.

translations.literal: Before long, Ying and Cang prefectures were again brought under its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward Ying and Cang were restored to its jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 廢河中節度，置河中五州都團練觀察使。

translations.literal: The Hezhong military governorship was abolished, and the Hezhong five-prefecture commander for training and observation was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Hezhong military governorship was abolished, and the Hezhong five-prefecture commander for training and observation was established.

translations.literal: 765, first year of the Yongtai era.
translations.idiomatic: 765 CE, first year of the Yongtai reign.

translations.literal: 766 CE, first year of the Dali reign.
translations.idiomatic: 766 CE, first year of the Dali reign.

sentences.zh: 相衛六州節度賜號昭義軍節度，後田承嗣盜取相、衛、洺、貝四州，所存者二州。

translations.literal: The Xiang-Wei six-prefecture circuit was granted the title Zhaoyi Army circuit; later Tian Chengsi seized Xiang, Wei, Ming, and Bei prefectures, leaving only two prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The Xiang–Wei six-prefecture circuit received the title Zhaoyi Army circuit; later Tian Chengsi seized four of its prefectures, leaving only two.

translations.literal: The Ze-Lu circuit added Ying Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Ze–Lu circuit gained Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 潁、鄭二州皆隸涇原節度。

translations.literal: Ying and Zheng prefectures were both placed under the Jingyuan circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Both Ying and Zheng prefectures were transferred to the Jingyuan circuit.

translations.literal: The Weibo circuit added Chan Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Weibo circuit gained Chan Prefecture.

translations.literal: The Chengde Army circuit added Cang Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Chengde Army circuit gained Cang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 瀛州隸幽州盧龍節度，滄州隸義武軍節度，德州隸淄青平盧節度。

translations.literal: Ying Prefecture was placed under the Youzhou Lu-Long circuit; Cang Prefecture under the Yiwu Army circuit; De Prefecture under the Ziqing Pinglu circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Ying Prefecture went to Youzhou Lu–Long, Cang Prefecture to the Yiwu Army, and De Prefecture to Ziqing Pinglu.

sentences.zh: 魏博節度增領衛、相、洺、貝四州。

translations.literal: The Weibo circuit added Wei, Xiang, Ming, and Bei prefectures—four in all—to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Weibo circuit gained Wei, Xiang, Ming, and Bei prefectures.

translations.literal: 780 CE, first year of the Jianzhong reign.
translations.idiomatic: 780 CE, first year of the Jianzhong reign.

sentences.zh: 昭義軍節度兼領澤、潞二州，徙治潞州。

translations.literal: The Zhaoyi Army circuit concurrently held Ze and Lu prefectures and moved its seat to Lu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhaoyi Army circuit also took Ze and Lu prefectures and transferred its seat to Lu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 昭義軍節度罷領懷衛二州、河陽三城。

translations.literal: The Zhaoyi Army circuit relinquished Huai and Wei prefectures and the Heyang Three Cities.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhaoyi Army circuit gave up Huai and Wei prefectures and the Heyang Three Cities.
Yan Prefecture was struck from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 昭義軍節度增領洺州，以趙州隸深趙節度。

translations.literal: The Zhaoyi Army circuit added Ming Prefecture; Zhao Prefecture was placed under the Shen-Zhao circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhaoyi Army circuit gained Ming Prefecture while Zhao Prefecture went to the Shen–Zhao circuit.

sentences.zh: 罷成德軍節度，置恆冀都團練觀察使，治恆州；深趙都團練觀察使，治趙州。

translations.literal: The Chengde Army circuit was abolished; the Heng-Ji commander for training and observation was established at Heng Prefecture, and the Shen-Zhao commander for training and observation at Zhao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Chengde Army circuit was abolished and replaced by Heng–Ji and Shen–Zhao training-and-observation commands seated at Heng and Zhao prefectures.

sentences.zh: 幽州節度復領德、棣二州，後以二州復隸成德軍節度。

translations.literal: The Youzhou circuit again took De and Di prefectures; later the two prefectures were again placed under the Chengde Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Youzhou circuit regained De and Di prefectures, but later both were transferred back to the Chengde Army circuit.

translations.literal: 784 CE, first year of the Xingyuan reign.
translations.idiomatic: 784 CE, first year of the Xingyuan reign.

sentences.zh: 置晉慈隰節度使，治晉州。尋罷，復置河中節度使，領河中府、同絳虢陝四州。

translations.literal: The Jin-Ci-Xi military commissioner was established, with seat at Jin Prefecture. Soon abolished; the Hezhong military commissioner was re-established, holding Hezhong Prefecture, Tong, Jiang, Guo, and Shan prefectures—four in all.
translations.idiomatic: A Jin–Ci–Xi military commissioner was posted to Jin Prefecture; soon after the post was abolished and the Hezhong military commissioner restored, commanding Hezhong Prefecture plus Tong, Jiang, Guo, and Shan.

sentences.zh: 廢恆冀、深趙二觀察，復置成德軍節度使，領恆、冀、趙、深四州，治恆州。

translations.literal: The Heng-Ji and Shen-Zhao observation commands were abolished; the Chengde Army military commissioner was re-established, holding Heng, Ji, Zhao, and Shen prefectures—four in all—with seat at Heng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The Heng–Ji and Shen–Zhao observation commands were abolished and the Chengde Army military commissioner restored over four prefectures from Heng Prefecture.

translations.literal: 785 CE, first year of the Zhenyuan reign.
translations.idiomatic: 785 CE, first year of the Zhenyuan reign.

sentences.zh: 河中節度罷領陝、虢二州。

translations.literal: The Hezhong circuit relinquished Shan and Guo prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The Hezhong circuit gave up Shan and Guo prefectures.

sentences.zh: 成德軍節度增領德、棣二州。

translations.literal: The Chengde Army circuit added De and Di prefectures to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Chengde Army circuit gained De and Di prefectures.

sentences.zh: 置德、棣二州都團練守捉使。

translations.literal: The De-Di chief commander for training and garrison was established.
translations.idiomatic: A chief training-and-garrison commander for De and Di prefectures was created.

translations.literal: Chen Prefecture was placed under the Chen-Xu circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Prefecture was transferred to the Chen–Xu circuit.

sentences.zh: 置橫海軍節度使，領滄、景二州，治滄州。

translations.literal: The Henghai Army military commissioner was established, holding Cang and Jing prefectures, with seat at Cang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Henghai Army military commissioner was appointed over Cang and Jing prefectures from his seat at Cang Prefecture.

translations.literal: The Jin-Ci-Xi defense and observation commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: A Jin–Ci–Xi defense and observation commissioner was created.

sentences.zh: 罷河中節度，置河中防禦觀察使。

translations.literal: The Hezhong military governorship was abolished; the Hezhong defense and observation commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Hezhong military governorship was abolished and replaced by a Hezhong defense and observation commissioner.

translations.literal: The Hezhong military commissioner was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: The Hezhong military commissioner was restored.

translations.literal: 805, first year of the Yongzhen era.
translations.idiomatic: 805 CE, first year of the Yongzhen reign.

translations.literal: 806, first year of the Yuanhe era.
translations.idiomatic: 806 CE, first year of the Yuanhe reign.

sentences.zh: 罷晉慈隰觀察使，以三州隸河中節度。

translations.literal: The Jin-Ci-Xi observation commissioner was abolished; the three prefectures were placed under the Hezhong circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin–Ci–Xi observation commissioner was abolished and the three prefectures transferred to the Hezhong circuit.

sentences.zh: 德、棣二州隸保信軍節度。

translations.literal: De and Di prefectures were placed under the Baoxin Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: De and Di prefectures were transferred to the Baoxin Army circuit.

sentences.zh: 置保信軍節度使，領德、棣二州，治德州。

translations.literal: The Baoxin Army military commissioner was established, holding De and Di prefectures, with seat at De Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Baoxin Army military commissioner was appointed over De and Di prefectures from his seat at De Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 成德軍節度復領德、棣二州。

translations.literal: The Chengde Army circuit again took De and Di prefectures under its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Chengde Army circuit regained De and Di prefectures.

sentences.zh: 廢保信軍節度使，以德、棣二州隸成德軍節度。

translations.literal: The Baoxin Army military commissioner was abolished; De and Di prefectures were placed under the Chengde Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Baoxin Army military commissioner was abolished and De and Di prefectures transferred to the Chengde Army circuit.

sentences.zh: 以德、棣二州隸橫海節度。

translations.literal: De and Di prefectures were placed under the Henghai circuit.
translations.idiomatic: De and Di prefectures were transferred to the Henghai circuit.

sentences.zh: 罷河中節度，置河中都防禦觀察使。

translations.literal: The Hezhong military governorship was abolished; the Hezhong capital defense and observation commissioner was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Hezhong military governorship was abolished and replaced by a Hezhong capital defense and observation commissioner.

translations.literal: The Hezhong military commissioner was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: The Hezhong military commissioner was restored.

translations.literal: 821 CE, first year of the Changqing reign.
translations.idiomatic: 821 CE, first year of the Changqing reign.

sentences.zh: 置深冀節度，治深州，尋罷，復以深冀隸成德軍節度。

translations.literal: The Shen-Ji military commission was established, with seat at Shen Prefecture; soon abolished, and Shen and Ji were again placed under the Chengde Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: A Shen–Ji military commission was created at Shen Prefecture, soon abolished, after which Shen and Ji returned to the Chengde Army circuit.

sentences.zh: 幽州節度罷領瀛、莫二州，置瀛莫都團練觀察使，治瀛州，尋升為節度使。

translations.literal: The Youzhou circuit relinquished Ying and Mo prefectures; the Ying-Mo commander for training and observation was established at Ying Prefecture and soon promoted to military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Youzhou circuit gave up Ying and Mo prefectures; a Ying–Mo training-and-observation command was created at Ying Prefecture and soon raised to a military commission.
Jing Prefecture was struck from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 置晉慈都團練觀察使，治晉州。

translations.literal: The Jin-Ci commander for training and observation was established, with seat at Jin Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: A Jin–Ci training-and-observation commander was appointed, headquartered at Jin Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 幽州節度復領瀛、莫二州。

translations.literal: The Youzhou circuit again took Ying and Mo prefectures under its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Youzhou circuit regained Ying and Mo prefectures.

translations.literal: The Ying-Mo military commissioner was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Ying–Mo military commissioner was abolished.

sentences.zh: 罷德、棣二州觀察處置使。

translations.literal: The observation and disposal commissioner for De and Di prefectures was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The observation and disposal commissioner for De and Di prefectures was discontinued.

translations.literal: The Henghai military commissioner again took Jing Prefecture under his jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Henghai military commissioner again assumed jurisdiction over Jing Prefecture.

translations.literal: 825, first year of the Baoli era.
translations.idiomatic: 825 CE, first year of the Baoli reign.

translations.literal: 827 CE, first year of the Dahe reign.
translations.idiomatic: 827 CE, first year of the Dahe reign.

sentences.zh: 升晉慈觀察使為保義軍節度。是年罷以二州隸河中節度。

translations.literal: The Jin-Ci observation commissioner was promoted to the Baoyi Army military commission. That year it was abolished and the two prefectures were placed under the Hezhong circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin–Ci observation commissioner was raised to the Baoyi Army military commission, then abolished that same year with its two prefectures transferred to Hezhong.

translations.literal: The Henghai circuit added Qi Prefecture to its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Henghai circuit gained Qi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 置相、衛、澶三州節度使，治相州，尋罷，三州復隸魏博。

translations.literal: The Xiang-Wei-Chan three-prefecture military commissioner was established, with seat at Xiang Prefecture; soon abolished, and the three prefectures returned to Weibo.
translations.idiomatic: A three-prefecture Xiang–Wei–Chan military commissioner was posted to Xiang Prefecture, soon abolished, after which all three prefectures reverted to Weibo.

sentences.zh: 罷橫海節度，更置齊德節度使，治德州，尋廢，復置，更號齊滄德節度使。

translations.literal: The Henghai circuit was abolished and replaced by the Qi-De military commissioner at De Prefecture; soon abolished, then re-established and retitled the Qi-Cang-De military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Henghai circuit was abolished in favor of a Qi–De commission at De Prefecture; after brief abolition it was restored as the Qi–Cang–De military commission.

sentences.zh: 齊德滄節度使賜號義昌軍節度。

translations.literal: The Qi-De-Cang military commissioner was granted the title Yichang Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Qi–De–Cang military commissioner received the title Yichang Army circuit.

translations.literal: 836, first year of the Kaicheng era.
translations.idiomatic: 836 CE, first year of the Kaicheng reign.

translations.literal: 841, first year of the Huichang era.
translations.idiomatic: 841 CE, first year of the Huichang reign.

translations.literal: Ze Prefecture was placed under the Heyang circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Ze Prefecture was transferred to the Heyang circuit.

translations.literal: 847, first year of the Dazhong era.
translations.idiomatic: 847 CE, first year of the Dazhong reign.

translations.literal: 860, first year of the Xiantong era.
translations.idiomatic: 860 CE, first year of the Xiantong reign.

translations.literal: 874, first year of the Qianfu era.
translations.idiomatic: 874 CE, first year of the Qianfu reign.

translations.literal: 880, first year of the Guangming era.
translations.idiomatic: 880 CE, first year of the Guangming reign.

translations.literal: 881, first year of the Zhonghe era.
translations.idiomatic: 881 CE, first year of the Zhonghe reign.

sentences.zh: 節度使孟方立徙昭義軍於邢州，而兼領潞州，自是五州有二昭義節度。

translations.literal: Military commissioner Meng Fangli moved the Zhaoyi Army to Xing Prefecture while also holding Luzhou; from this time the five prefectures had two Zhaoyi circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Military commissioner Meng Fangli transferred the Zhaoyi Army to Xing Prefecture while concurrently commanding Luzhou; thereafter the five prefectures were served by two Zhaoyi circuits.

translations.literal: 885, first year of the Guangqi era.
translations.idiomatic: 885 CE, first year of the Guangqi reign.

sentences.zh: 賜河中節度號護國軍節度。

translations.literal: The Hezhong circuit was granted the designation Huguo Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Hezhong circuit received the title Huguo Army circuit.

translations.literal: 888, first year of the Wende era.
translations.idiomatic: 888 CE, first year of the Wende reign.

translations.literal: 889, first year of the Longji era.
translations.idiomatic: 889 CE, first year of the Longji reign.

translations.literal: 890, first year of the Dashun era.
translations.idiomatic: 890 CE, first year of the Dashun reign.

translations.literal: 892, first year of the Jingfu era.
translations.idiomatic: 892 CE, first year of the Jingfu reign.

translations.literal: The Yichang Army circuit again took Jing Prefecture under its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Yichang Army circuit again assumed jurisdiction over Jing Prefecture.

translations.literal: 894, first year of the Qianning era.
translations.idiomatic: 894 CE, first year of the Qianning reign.

translations.literal: Qi Prefecture was placed under the Wusu Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Qi Prefecture was transferred to the Wusu Army circuit.

translations.literal: 898, first year of the Guanghua era.
translations.idiomatic: 898 CE, first year of the Guanghua reign.

translations.literal: 901 CE, first year of the Tianfu reign.
translations.idiomatic: 901 CE, first year of the Tianfu reign.

sentences.zh: 二昭義軍節度合為一，復領澤州。

translations.literal: The two Zhaoyi Army circuits were merged into one and again took Ze Prefecture under their jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The two Zhaoyi Army circuits were united into one command, which again assumed Ze Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 置平、營、瀛、莫等州觀察使。

translations.literal: The observation commissioner for Ping, Ying, Ying, Mo, and other prefectures was established.
translations.idiomatic: An observation commissioner for Ping, Ying, Mo, and neighboring prefectures was appointed.

translations.literal: 904 CE, first year of the Tianyou reign.
translations.idiomatic: 904 CE, first year of the Tianyou reign.

sentences.zh: 更成德軍節度號武順軍節度。

translations.literal: The Chengde Army circuit was retitled the Wushun Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Chengde Army circuit was renamed the Wushun Army circuit.

sentences.zh: 賜魏博節度號天雄軍節度。

translations.literal: The Weibo circuit was granted the designation Tianxiong Army circuit.
translations.idiomatic: The Weibo circuit received the title Tianxiong Army circuit.
